# Tencent TokenHub

Use `tencent-tokenhub/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "tencent-tokenhub-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "tencent-tokenhub/hy3",
});
```

## Environment variables

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://tokenhub.tencentmaas.com/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `TENCENT_TOKENHUB_BASE_URL`.
